title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 2 Message to the 7 Churches

sense.text: “Through faith we understand that the worlds were framed by the word of God”. Everything happens because the Lord allows it. There is a power behind what your eyes see; what you see is not always what it is. Remember the servant whose eyes had to be opened to see the army with the prophet. In these latter days, do not lean on your own understanding, speak foolishly, or lose faith because you cannot see what God is doing. Put your trust in God and stay upon this faith. The Lord can be doing something greater than the thing you are looking at.

“For when they shall say, Peace and safety; then sudden destruction cometh upon them, as travail upon a woman with child”. These global problems are contractions. A woman has a contraction, then a pause, then another; the contractions get closer together, from five minutes to four, three, two, one, until the baby comes. Likewise trouble comes, slows down, and makes people think everything is all right, then another trouble hits. The Lord makes his entrance at the end of those contractions, like a thief in the night.

Do not sleep on what is happening. Esau is doing an experiment on us: a social experiment to see how society reacts to an alleged pandemic. Esau is buying up all manner of guns, and the stores have run out of bullets. It is only the beginning. A peace agreement between America and Iran does not mean safety, and China is not the next world ruler. After Esau comes Israel; that is our time to rule. Keep faith through the lulls as well as the trouble.

“Moreover I freely set at liberty every one of the Jews, that were carried captives out of the land of Judea into any part of my kingdom”. Part of his kingdom was Asia Minor. Our people were scattered throughout the area of the Greek Empire; diaspora means scattered.

In the history of the northern diaspora, the Seleucids took Judea and Antiochus III moved several thousand Jewish soldiers and their families from Babylonia to Asia Minor. When you read about the seven churches of Asia Minor, these are Jews. These are not other races; these are our people that were scattered throughout Asia Minor, put there by King Antiochus.

This is why Esau, cleverly, craftily, said remove the book of Maccabees, the books of the Apocrypha: so that when they read the New Testament they are all confused, and say it’s anybody that believes in Jesus. Nope, it’s not anybody. These are Jews.

And they always throw the suffix ish on: Jewish. That is to make you think it’s talking about white folks. Ish is a suffix that means somewhat like, not the original; meet me around five-ish is a little before five or a little after, but not five o’clock. When they say they are Jewish, they are telling you in that one word that they are converts, not the originals.

John was exiled on the island of Patmos. Look at its location in relation to Asia Minor: the seven churches were in that region of the Greek empire, where our people had been scattered. Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamos, Thyatira and the other churches were Israelite congregations in those settlements. That history and geography come before reading the messages to their leaders.

“Unto the angel of the church of Ephesus write”. The angel is the leader of the church, a man entrusted with the congregation. This is not a letter addressed to Michael, Gabriel or another heavenly angel. Christ holds the seven stars and walks among the seven golden candlesticks: the stars are the leaders and the candlesticks are the seven churches, like the seven-branched menorah.

Christ knows their works, labour and patience. They cannot bear them which are evil, and they have tried them which say they are apostles and are not, and found them liars. In the church at Ephesus men were trying to set themselves up as apostles: phonies, more than likely younger men who came in and desired to sit in a seat of authority with no experience, understanding or knowledge to sit in that seat.

It is the old expression: don’t compare your chapter 2 to our chapter 30. I’m on chapter 2; well, we’re on chapter 30. Shut the hell up, sit down and just listen.

“And hast borne, and hast patience, and for my name’s sake hast laboured, and hast not fainted.” They carried this truth, endured and kept working for Christ without giving up. These are good works, and Christ acknowledges them before correcting what is wrong.

“because thou hast left thy first love”. The first love is Christ. A congregation can have patience, labour and the ability to expose false teachers and still need this correction. Loving Christ cannot be separated from loving the brothers he has put before you. God first showed his love by sending his Son; that obligates us to love one another.

precepts.why: “thou art good in my sight, as an angel of God”. Achish is speaking to David, a man. Angel can mean a human messenger. That is how the angel addressed in Ephesus is the man leading that church, not one of the heavenly angels.

“The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches: and the seven candlesticks which thou sawest are the seven churches.” Revelation gives its own explanation. The stars in Christ's right hand are the leaders; the seven golden candlesticks are their congregations. Christ is walking in the midst of those churches.

Paul cuts off the occasion sought by men who want to glory as though they have the same standing as the apostles. “For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” They were pretending to be men Christ had taught, pretending to have walked with him. The false apostles were inside the church, not merely enemies outside it.

“for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” That is a deep mystery, worded that way on purpose: when Satan was in the garden he did not come as a serpent crawling on the ground. He came like an angel of light. Write that precept down. Likewise his ministers transform themselves into ministers of righteousness, though their end is according to their works. Men can be among the congregation, look righteous and still be ministers of Satan, disrespecting Paul, Peter, James and John.

“Let no man think me a fool”. Paul is not stupid. If they insist on treating him like a fool, receive him as a fool while he boasts a little and gives his credentials. He has to establish what he has actually done because deceitful men are trying to put themselves on the same level. That is the kind of claim Ephesus tested and found to be a lie.

God manifested his love by sending his only begotten Son so that we might live through him. Christ is the first creation, the Alpha and Omega, and the propitiation, the mediator for our sins. We did not love God first; he loved us and sent his Son. If God so loved us, we ought to love one another.

“We love him, because he first loved us.”. Then John puts that love to the test: “If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar”. How are you going to love God, whom you have not seen, while hating your brother, whom you have seen? Claiming to love Christ while rejecting the brothers is hypocrisy. That is how to examine whether you have left your first love.

The Church of Ephesus left their first love, which was Christ. “Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little.” Kiss the Son: that is Christ. It means what Christ said in John 14:15: if you love me, keep my commandments. That is what David is saying in Psalms.

Lest he be angry, mad as hell at thee, and ye perish from the way: he kills you, puts you to death, when his wrath is kindled but a little. “Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.” Leaving the first love is leaving the commandments.

sense.text: “that ye all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you”. The requirement is one mind and one judgment. Paul heard from the household of Chloe that there were contentions among them. Unity is the correction; picking a faction is the problem.

Some said they were of Paul, some Apollos, some Cephas, and some Christ. All four parties were wrong. Saying that you only follow Christ sounds righteous, but in that contention it was another division. “Is Christ divided?” No. Paul was not crucified for them and they were not baptized in Paul's name.

Christ was not walking the earth during the time of the Corinthians; they never saw him. So what do they mean, they only follow Christ? You got to watch spirits that say I only follow Christ. They mean they can do whatever the hell they want; there’s nobody that can check them or correct them. It’ll be the same ones that say women can wear pants, you can eat pork if you want, and you can’t correct me cuz you ain’t Christ. Watch those evil Negro black and brown spirits. That’s a dumb spirit.

It is always some black assy devil today that says I don’t follow no man, I only follow Christ: like Christ woke them up and said, let me give you the understanding, go to Deuteronomy 28, I’m going to teach you that you’re an Israelite. There is a brother in Harlem who says he went to Mount Sinai and the archangel came down and taught him, and a whole group of people believe that thing. He used to read for Deacon Yas when he was fifteen years old, and we got the video proof that he learned under us.

It is the same spirit as in the time of Moses: we don’t want to hear you, Moses, we want to hear the Most High. Then when the Lord spoke they were scared to death, the mountains blowing up, thunder and lightning, and they said, Moses, we’ll listen to you now.

precepts.why: “for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?” You have seen the brothers Christ uses, but you have not seen Christ. Rejecting all those brothers while claiming you only love Christ does not fulfill this command. It is the same problem as claiming Christ as a faction against the men he sent.

Philip heard the eunuch reading Esaias and asked whether he understood. “How can I, except some man should guide me?” The eunuch asked Philip to sit with him. He needed a man to guide him in the scriptures. Having a Bible in your hand does not remove the need for teachers appointed by God. That is why the party claiming only Christ was wrong along with the other factions.

sense.text:
Remember where you fell, repent and do the first works. Go back to the zeal you had when you first heard the truth, when you wanted to study and do the work. Examine yourself instead of making everybody else prove what is wrong with you. Your works speak. Many a time we stand up and say, this is a good brother, and that brother turns around and does something dumb as hell, like giving out answers on a test. Not that brother, we love that brother; then lo and behold he did it, and now we have egg on our face.

Worldly cares, money and lust can choke the word. Brothers in Austin let money problems overthrow them and would not repent. Being removed and then saying that you are still in the truth, without correcting the sin, is not repentance. Get back to your first works; if opening the Bible now only makes you fall asleep, recognize that change.

“or else I will come unto thee quickly, and will remove thy candlestick out of his place, except thou repent.” The candlestick is the church and its light is the law and understanding. Christ can take that understanding away. Whatever little truth you still have can be removed if you will not repent.

The Nicolaitans were Israelites worshipping the Greek god Nike, which meant god of victory. Christ hates those deeds. He does not accept every form of worship simply because an Israelite practices it. Ephesus was right to hate what he hates.

Hear what the Spirit says to the churches. The promise to the one who overcomes is to eat of the tree of life in the paradise of God. Eating is learning the doctrine of life, the knowledge of God's commandments. The fruit is immortality, living and ruling for ever. Do not reduce the tree to Eve eating an apple; understand what that eating represents.

precepts.why: “Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” Find where you went wrong and correct it. Do not make this everybody else's responsibility. Christ is in you unless you are reprobates, void of judgment. Look at your works and examine what only you and the Lord know, not just the appearance you have before the brothers.

The seed among thorns is people who hear the word, but the cares of this world, the deceitfulness of riches and the lusts of other things enter and choke it, leaving it unfruitful. Money and sex are two great stumbling blocks. You can have heard and received the truth and then let these things destroy it. That is how somebody who once had zeal needs to return to the first works.

“For the commandment is a lamp; and the law is light; and reproofs of instruction are the way of life”. The candlestick carries the light of God's law. Refusing the reproof that leads to life brings the threat of losing that light. So Christ is saying to the Church of Ephesus: you leaders better get it right, or I am going to snuff out your candlestick. There won’t be no more Ephesus; y’all going to be done.

“unto every one which hath shall be given; and from him that hath not, even that he hath shall be taken away from him.” Those who have understanding receive more. If you let it go, even the little you still have is taken away. That is what removing the candlestick means.

“The knowledge of the commandments of the Lord is the doctrine of life: and they that do things that please him shall receive the fruit of the tree of immortality.”. Knowledge of the commandments is the doctrine of life. The people who do what pleases God receive the fruit of that tree, immortality. Eating the tree of life means receiving and doing this doctrine, not eating a literal apple.

sense.text: The angel of Smyrna is its leader, just as the angel of Ephesus is a man. The first and the last, who was dead and is alive, is Christ. Smyrna, Ephesus and Pergamos competed for the standing of chief city in Asia Minor. Smyrna became a bishopric, a church under a bishop, growing from the Jewish colony there. Keep that Israelite history in mind.

Christ knows the works of the Israelites in Smyrna. They did a lot of works because they were a colony of Rome, they caught a lot of tribulation, and they were deeply impoverished. But thou art rich, because all the promises in the Bible pertain to the Israelites, and the Church of Smyrna was a part of them.

“I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan.” Christian commentaries say this verse is speaking of the scribes and Pharisees and nothing else. That is not true. Christ himself told the Pharisees they were Abraham’s seed: they were Jews, following their father Rome. The ones who say they are Jews and are not are Idumea, Edom: the robbers of our people who exalt themselves as the Jews, the Edomite Herods set up as kings of Judea, and the white man who took the land in 1948 and established himself as the Jewish people.

precepts.why: “but received me as an angel of God”. Paul is a man, and the Galatians received him as God's messenger. That is another example of angel describing a human leader, explaining the angel of the church in Smyrna.

“his bishoprick let another take.” Judas held an office among the apostles; after his death another was to take that office. Remember, Judas Iscariot was an apostle: bishoprick is another term for the office of apostle. That is what the history means when it says a bishoprick existed in Smyrna from a very early time, originating in the considerable Jewish colony there. These were Jews, not other races.

Christ was talking to the Jews: “Then said Jesus to those Jews which believed on him”. Some believed and some did not. The ones who did not answered, “We be Abraham’s seed, and were never in bondage to any man: how sayest thou, Ye shall be made free?”

Christ says to them, “I know that ye are Abraham’s seed; but ye seek to kill me, because my word hath no place in you.” I know you are Abraham’s seed. Yes, you are Jews.

“Ye are of your father the devil, and the lusts of your father ye will do.” The devil he is making reference to is not only the spiritual demon Satan. Who were the Pharisees following? Who were they afraid of? Rome. You are of your father Rome. “He was a murderer from the beginning”: that was Cain. That Roman Empire was Cain before the flood, and the Roman Empire was Esau after the flood, and the Pharisees obeyed Rome.

So the commentaries are wrong to say Revelation 2:9 is only the scribes and Pharisees. Christ said they were Jews, of their father the devil. The ones who say they are Jews and are not are someone else.

“And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south”: the king of the south was the Ptolemy dynasty. “Also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.” The robbers of thy people exalt themselves as the Jews, to establish the vision that they are the Jews.

It was prophesied that a group of people would rob our heritage. Not only our heritage: they would rob our land, our country, our name, everything, and seek to establish the vision that they are the sons and daughters of God. But they shall fall.

The preacher in the video says Jerusalem will be the capital of Israel. He is referring to President Donald Trump moving the embassy from Tel Aviv to Jerusalem: he is trying to establish the vision.

“There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea”. Being called king of Judaea does not make Herod an original Israelite. The dictionary identifies the Herods as Idumaean rulers of Palestine. Idumaea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom. Rome installed a converted Edomite family as kings over our people.

Paul says, “I think myself happy, king Agrippa, because I shall answer for myself this day before thee touching all the things whereof I am accused of the Jews: Especially because I know thee to be expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews”.

Why was Agrippa expert in all the customs and questions among the Jews? Because they were circumcised. They were converts, just like Herod; this is the same family line. They converted to what they call Judaism and studied all our laws and customs. That is why Rome set Herod up as king of Judah: a white man set up over us. They set themselves up as Jewish, and Jewish, as read at the beginning of the class, means converts.

More prophecy to explain the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews and are not. “Surely in the fire of my jealousy have I spoken against the residue of the heathen, and against all Idumea”. Idumea is the Greek and Roman name for Edom, “which have appointed my land into their possession”.

That is the prophecy of May 14th, 1948, when the white man took the land and established themselves as the Jewish people, “with the joy of all their heart, with despiteful minds, to cast it out for a prey.” Then they let the other nations come in: come take a part of this land, come be with friends. These are plain prophecies of the white man establishing themselves as Jewish people.

Then the class played the world famous, or infamous, Greg Laurie, in his video Israel and Magog: the prophetic clock started to tick May 14th, 1948, he says, and he reads David Jeremiah’s line that never had a decimated ancient people managed to retain their identity through almost 20 centuries and reestablish their nation. Notice he is not using scripture. He is not explaining verse upon verse, precept upon precept; he paraphrases the scripture, throws it out there, and the audience goes yes.

sense.text:
If those people are the Jews of the Bible, this is what is supposed to be happening. “For the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the strangers shall be joined with them”. That is what they are saying about May 14th, 1948. Really? Let’s see if that is what it is talking about.

“The house of Israel shall possess them in the land of the Lord for servants and handmaids”: slaves. Slaves. Where are the slaves that they are supposed to bring up over there? “And they shall take them captives, whose captives they were”: who were these people captive to? They ain’t captive to nobody. “And they shall rule over their oppressors”: who are they ruling? The hell is this?

“And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”. They say, oh, the Holocaust: five years. You mean to tell me you are complaining because you suffered a little bit for five years? Your five years compares with almost 500 years that we have gone through? If that is hard bondage, what was the bondage we went through?

That is why the Most High put hard on there. He is specifying a particular bondage, one that is totally unforgettable everywhere: the hard bondage of the people he will give rest.

If those in the land today are the Jews of the Bible, here is something else that would be going on. “The mountain of the Lord’s house shall be established in the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills”. We have been to Israel: it is not at the top of no mountain, it is a desert in a valley, and that land is not exalted above no governments. “All nations shall flow unto it”: that is Israel coming out of all nations, and they ain’t flowing to that.

“For out of Zion shall go forth the law”. Is the law being taught out of there? No. All you got over there is hatred and racism, and they are knocking Palestinians upside their head and shooting them. They had the damn gay parade out there; they got pork stores out there, transgender LGBT marches. You’re an idiot if you think those people in Israel today are the prophetic fulfillment of the scriptures we read about.

Greg Laurie keeps using the word Jewish. He knows most people don’t look that word up. He is telling you the converts took the city: the Idumeans took the city when Jerusalem came under Jewish control in the ’67 war.

“And he shall judge among the nations, and shall rebuke many people: and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruninghooks: nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.” When the twelve tribes of Israel return to the land there is going to be world peace. Is there world peace today? Hell no. So they are not the biblical Jews at all.

Foreign policy and the United Nations are trying to make everybody believe the move in 1948 was the establishment of the Jews, fighting biblical prophecy. Imagine the pandemonium when the world finds out that you are the real Jews all over this planet Earth. They are trying to stop that by establishing these people as the Jews.

precepts.why:
Here is the conflict. “I will also gather all nations, and will bring them down into the valley of Jehoshaphat, and will plead with them there for my people and for my heritage Israel, whom they have scattered among the nations, and parted my land.” Parted my land: Greg Laurie, we just told you who it is parted between. It is parted between the Palestinians and the Jewish people.

That is the controversy Joel 3:2 is talking about: the Jewish people, which are Idumean, arguing and fighting with the so-called Arabs, the Palestinians. Once the real Jews go back to the land there ain’t supposed to be no conflict, as Isaiah 2:4 says.

sense.text:
“for under the whole heaven hath not been done as hath been done upon Jerusalem.” God confirmed the evil he spoke against us and our judges. The curses beginning at Deuteronomy 28:15 and continuing through verse 68 describe the calamities upon our people: enslavement, removal, rape, mutilation, the destruction of families and the loss of language, nationality and heritage. The twelve tribes are the so-called blacks, Latinos and Native American Indians. There is no nation on earth whose atrocities can be equaled to what happened to them. You cannot compare a five-year Holocaust to what happened to us.

Imagine this: cast out and chased from our homeland from 70 AD on, slaughtered day after day, hunted in the continent of Africa, forced to mingle in and blend with the Hamitic tribes down there; going into slavery and being colonized, losing our identity, our language, our culture, our heritage; whipped and beaten, raped and castrated. And I am only talking from 1492 on up. They say 200 million died during the Middle Passage from Africa to the United States, and over 700 million North American Indians were slaughtered, from North America down to South. And you are going to throw a measly six million during a five-year span? You’re an idiot. We was in freaking Nigeria, and the Igbo Negro said that what the Jewish people suffered for five years was worse than what blacks suffered. The audience cursed his ashy behind out; they dropped every F bomb you can imagine on this old fool. He was an idiot. The white man got some powerful brainwashing.

Greg Laurie tells you to walk through Yad Vashem or the Holocaust museum in Washington and look at the six million. They always talk about six million during a five-year span: the alleged six million. Take your six million in five years; now take the hundreds and hundreds of millions that died for the past 500 years.

The oppression also continues through debt and control of nations: Haiti was made to pay France for its freedom, Aristide demanded the money back, and Africa is told: put your money in our bank and we will give it to you when you need it. They collected $500 billion from Africa’s resources while the children have no shoes on their feet, then say, I tell you what, I’m going to let you borrow $40 million, but you still got to give me 500 billion. Haiti is charged for the money France lost by no longer having them as slaves. If you do not know what evil is, think about that: that is the white man being the devil. When Guinea demanded independence in 1958, France destroyed what it could rather than simply leave the country free. These are parts of the breach that only Christ can heal.

precepts.why: “for thy breach is great like the sea: who can heal thee?” What people can be compared to Jerusalem in order to comfort her? Our breach is as great as the sea. The centuries of captivity, destroyed families, loss of names and language, and continuing exploitation cannot be healed by those who inflicted them. Only Christ can heal that breach. This explains the evil Daniel says has not been done to another people under the whole heaven.

sense.text:
Greg Laurie’s whole sermon is based on Ezekiel 38: Israel will be attacked by a nation to her north; not yet, but in process. Ezekiel 38 ain’t talking about them people that live over there. His checklist: scattered to the four corners of the earth, check; regathered, check. So these white people that came from Poland, Germany, Czechoslovakia, Uzbekistan, that’s the four corners of the earth? Whoever believes that is an idiot. Ask the white men in Israel: where is the tribe of Issachar, where’s Manasseh, where is Gad, where is Reuben, where’s Benjamin, where’s Ephraim and Zebulon, Naphtali? Where they at? They just lie, and our people in these churches fall for the okey-doke because of his red pink skin.

“Thou shalt come into the land that is brought back from the sword”: brought back from destruction, from judgment, “and is gathered out of many people”: the Israelites come out of many nations, “and they shall dwell safely all of them.” Are those people over there dwelling safely? No, hell no. So this chapter is not talking about this time period.

“I will go up to the land of unwalled villages; I will go to them that are at rest, that dwell safely”. Are they at rest over there? No. They don’t dwell safely over there; it’s always some kind of problem over there. “Having neither bars nor gates”: we’ve been there, and there’s bars and gates around the land. This has nothing to do with those people over there today. It is Revelation 20: after the thousand years, when Satan is loosed and the nations come up against the saints and the beloved city.

precepts.why:
After the thousand years are expired, Satan is loosed out of prison. He goes out to deceive the nations in the four quarters of the earth, Gog and Magog, and gathers them in a number like the sand of the sea. They surround the camp of the saints and the beloved city, and fire comes down from God out of heaven to devour them.

That is the timing of Ezekiel 38. The white man is released after the thousand years, gathers the nations against the kingdom, and God destroys that assault. Applying Gog and Magog to the people currently occupying the land overlooks both the thousand years and the condition of the restored people dwelling safely.

sense.text: “I know the blasphemy of them which say they are Jews, and are not, but are the synagogue of Satan”: that is talking about Idumea, Edom. That’s who it’s talking about.

Fear none of the things you will suffer. The devil casts some into prison so they may be tried, just as Herod imprisoned the apostles under Rome. Ten days is the period of tribulation appointed to them. Christ commands faithfulness unto death and promises a crown of life. Some of us may have to die for the truth; that death is precious to the Lord.

The one who overcomes will not be hurt by the second death. That is the lake of fire, not ordinary death. The first resurrection is at Christ's coming; the elect have already been judged and the second death has no power over them. The rest of the dead come afterward, when the thousand years are finished.

Do not assume that being your mother or father makes somebody exempt. Family members who died without believing will face that judgment. Burning a body or scattering ashes in the sea does not prevent resurrection. God brings the dead back from wherever they are and judges every man according to his works.

When that last judgment comes: bye-bye Ma, bye-bye Dad, Shalom. I tried to warn you, but you didn’t listen. Nothing I could do for you now.

precepts.why:
Herod stretched out his hands against the church, killed James the brother of John with the sword, and then took Peter because killing James pleased the Jews. Peter was apprehended and put in prison. Herod is the Edomite ruler under Rome. That history shows the devil casting believers into prison and trying them; the warning to Smyrna is something the church had already experienced.

So understand this: this is not any kind of racist rhetoric. This is straight Bible fact.

“Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.”. If you remain faithful and die in the Lord, your death is precious in his sight. Christ's promise of the crown of life gives the strength to face imprisonment and death without abandoning the faith.

John sees the great white throne and the one before whose face earth and heaven flee. It is a dreadful judgment. The dead, small and great, stand before God; the books are opened, along with the book of life, and the dead are judged according to their works. The books include the Bible by which the works are judged and the record of those works; the book of life identifies those who receive life.

The sea gives up its dead and death and hell give up theirs. It does not matter whether a person was buried, drowned, burned or had ashes scattered. God can bring every one back. Death and hell are cast into the lake of fire: “This is the second death.” That is the death Christ promises the overcomer will not suffer.

The rest of the dead do not live again until the thousand years are finished. Blessed and holy is the person who has part in the first resurrection: “on such the second death hath no power”. The first resurrection is when Christ returns for the elect. They have already been judged and are blessed; the remaining dead, including unbelieving relatives, face the later judgment. Do not confuse those two groups or those two times.

“the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life”. Eternal life is what we want. The elect in the first resurrection have already been judged and do not have to fear the second death. If relatives rejected the truth and died in their sins, their relationship to us does not exempt them from the later judgment.

sense.text: Christ has the sharp sword with two edges. He addresses the leader of Pergamos and knows where they live, even where Satan's seat is. Pergamos was a large city that dealt with a lot of demonic activity; Satan’s seat was there. Yet they hold fast his name and have not denied the faith, even when Antipas, his faithful martyr, was killed among them. Do not be ashamed of the words of the Bible or surrender them because somebody threatens you.

There are still a few things against this church. Some hold the doctrine of Balaam, who taught Balac to put a stumbling block before Israel: food sacrificed to idols and fornication. Balaam loved the wages of unrighteousness. Covetousness and women became the means of turning Israel from God.

Balaam’s counsel was: we can’t beat the men, send women among them. In the turbulent 60s, with the black radical groups, what did the white man do? Send the white woman. They made a joke of it in Undercover Brother with Eddie Griffin: we can’t take them down, send in the black man’s Kryptonite, and the white woman comes walking in, in slow motion, in a white tight leather outfit, Becky with the good hair. After Loving v. Virginia, black and Latino men went crazy: no other race of men has done more interracial marriage than black and Hispanic men.

When a white man and other nations send in their women, believe me, it is for a political reason. Any black man who makes good money, an athlete, an entertainer: there is a certain group of white women they send in. Not the fat ones with missing teeth; the good looking ones. Then all of a sudden you find yourself dead, all that money goes to her, and she goes, look daddy, I got us some money, just like you taught me. In Greenleaf the white man tells the black man who wants to be pastor over the mega church, you’re going to marry my daughter, so the millions go to her. Marriage has always been a political institution. She loves me, mama? She don’t love you; it’s political.

In Africa the Chinese do the same: they marry the women in Uganda, Sierra Leone and Liberia to get the land in their name, then leave them with the children.

Pergamos also has those holding the doctrine of the Nicolaitans, the worship of the Greek god Nike, the Greek god of victory, which Christ hates. His command is repent. Otherwise he comes quickly and fights against them with the sword of his mouth. That group, I’mma fight against them with the word of God, I’m going to kill them: that’s what he’s warning them in Pergamos.

The overcomer receives the hidden manna. Christ is that bread from heaven; it is not merely the physical bread the fathers ate in the wilderness. Receiving his doctrine gives life. The white stone and the new name are further promises to the one who overcomes.

precepts.why:
This is talking about Nineveh in the first, literal sense, but it is also a metaphor for America. “Because of the multitude of the whoredoms of the wellfavoured harlot”: the wellfavoured harlot is the United States of America, the mother of harlots of Revelation 17:5. Everybody loves that hoe called America.

“The mistress of witchcrafts”: Haiti thought they got witchcraft; America says you ain’t got nothing on us, we are the mistress of witchcrafts. “That selleth nations through her whoredoms”: we have been sold. All twelve tribes have been sold into slavery. “And families through her witchcrafts.” That is the seat of Satan these last days, and Pergamos dwelt where Satan’s seat is.

“For whosoever shall be ashamed of me and of my words, of him shall the Son of man be ashamed”. Christ comes in his glory, his Father's glory and that of the holy angels. Do not be ashamed of what the Bible actually says. Holding his name and refusing to deny the faith means standing by his words when they are unpopular or dangerous.

Parents, brethren, kinsfolk and friends will betray believers, and some will be put to death. Some, not all: everybody is not going to be physically murdered, but some of us are slotted to die in this truth. Even the people closest to you may betray you; we have seen that spirit, including the betrayals in 2018. Antipas was killed, but the church still had to hold the faith. Do not make your loyalty depend on whether relatives or friends remain loyal.

“Which have forsaken the right way, and are gone astray, following the way of Balaam the son of Bosor, who loved the wages of unrighteousness”. Balaam was covetous; all he was about was the money. Most of the group that ran up out of here loved the wages of unrighteousness.

One little Hispanic boy said, I will never do another art for IUIC unless you pay me to do the work. Bro, this work is not for us; this is to exalt the people, this is for the Lord’s work. Some of them held us hostage on videos: we had to wait a year for the next Passover video. And the Lord said, I got other brothers that’s going to do it quick, and better: everybody was shocked when Yuri and Solomon put the videos up the same day. Them damn Hispanic brothers held us hostage for years and wouldn’t do nothing unless they got money: wicked as hell.

Some people still sitting up in here follow Balaam: they don’t give a damn about this truth; they look at the videos. One Israelite froze the video, said give me a pen, counted heads, one, two, three, and started multiplying by shirts and posters: all his whole thing was money. Others said, I got five wives, I could buy them all new cars and new shoes. It ain’t about the Lord at all; it’s taking care of them hoes.

Israel abode in Shittim and began committing whoredom with the daughters of Moab. That is the stumbling block Balaam's counsel put before the people. The women drew Israel into fornication and the worship connected with it.

Moses asked why the women had been kept alive. “these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the Lord in the matter of Peor”. A plague came among the congregation because of that trespass. Balaam could not simply curse Israel as Balac wanted, so his counsel used the women to make Israel sin and bring judgment on themselves. Money, political advantage and attractive marriages can still be used to lead men into that same disobedience.

sense.text: Our fathers ate manna in the desert, bread from heaven. Christ explains that Moses did not give the true bread; the Father gives the true bread from heaven, which comes down and gives life to the world. The world here is Israel. The manna in the wilderness was a figure pointing to Christ.

They ask for that bread always, and Christ answers that he is the bread of life. Coming to him and believing in him satisfies hunger and thirst. They had seen him and still did not believe. The hidden manna is Christ and his doctrine, not a promise that ordinary bread will make the flesh immortal.

All whom the Father gives Christ will come to him, and he will not cast out the one who comes. The Father chooses who receives this understanding. Christ came down from heaven to do the will of the one who sent him, not his own will.

The one who believes on Christ has everlasting life. The fathers ate manna and are dead; that physical bread did not prevent death. Christ is the living bread from heaven, and the one who eats it lives for ever. His flesh is given for the life of the world, Israel. Breaking bread points to receiving him and learning his doctrine. That explains the hidden manna promised to the overcomer in Revelation.

precepts.why:
We are reading about the hidden manna: it represents Christ and what he taught. “But if our gospel be hid, it is hid to them that are lost”: you don’t understand who Christ is, you don’t understand the black Messiah came for the nation of Israel; you’re lost, I can’t help you.

“In whom the god of this world hath blinded the minds of them which believe not”: because you love the white man. The white man is the god of this world.

sense.text:
The overcomer receives a white stone with a new name written in it, known only to the person who receives it. That new name is the true name, the one you had before the world, not another name for men to argue over now. We do not remember those former things in this life.

John the Baptist did not know that he had been Elijah, but Christ knew. You cannot use your lack of remembrance as proof that there was no former existence. In the kingdom the Lord gives the name he has appointed, and only the recipient knows it. Stop making today's assumed names a quarrel among the people.

precepts.why:
“And now when I prepared the world, which was not yet made, even for them to dwell in that now live, no man spake against me.” This is the Lord speaking, talking about the Israelites. We were all with him in the very beginning, before he prepared the world. That is why no man spake against him: we were there, and we were all in agreement to what God’s plan was.

In the beginning, before everything was made, in the spirit world God chose certain spirits to come down on the earth as the Israelites, and we all agreed in that counsel. Now we are here in this flesh with no remembrance of the things that happened. Your new name is your true name.

“There is no remembrance of former things”. Neither will there be remembrance of the things to come among those who come afterward. We do not remember our former lives. John the Baptist not remembering Elijah does not overturn what Christ knew about him. The name given in the kingdom is the true name whose former memory we do not have now.

Zion's righteousness goes forth as brightness and her salvation as a burning lamp. The Gentiles see that righteousness and kings see her glory. “and thou shalt be called by a new name, which the mouth of the Lord shall name.” The Lord names it. Do not waste time arguing over the names people claim today when God has promised the name he himself will give.

“Him that overcometh will I make a pillar in the temple of my God”: to be made a pillar means to be made a leader. “And he shall go no more out”: you ain’t going out into captivity no more. “And I will write upon him the name of my God, and the name of the city of my God, which is new Jerusalem, which cometh down out of heaven from my God: and I will write upon him my new name.”

Those are the names we had from way back, the very beginning, before the world was made. Christ also has a name no man knows but he himself. In the kingdom we are all going to know each other’s true names, the Son’s name and the Father’s name. So stop arguing over names: the white man is taking over the whole planet Earth and Negroes are arguing about names.

sense.text: The message goes to the leader in Thyatira, a city whose name means daughter. On the map it is close to Ephesus and Pergamos; these congregations lived among the same Greek influences. The Son of God has eyes like a flame of fire and feet like fine brass. He sees the works and the problems of the church.

Christ knows their works, charity, service, faith and patience. Charity is a Greek word for love: the love you have for neighbours, for brothers and sisters. And servants: that’s Leviticus 25:55. Their last works are more than the first. This is a working congregation with real good in it, yet it must still correct what follows.

They suffer that woman Jezebel, which calleth herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce Christ’s servants to commit fornication and to eat things sacrificed unto idols. This Jezebel is not the Jezebel of the book of Kings; two different time periods. But spiritually, if your wife is a Jezebel, you are an Ahab. The qualities of an Ahab: weak, mentally insecure, allows the wife to do whatever the hell she wants. Some of you men listening are Ahabs, married to Jezebels. Jezebel is sitting in here; Jezebel is listening online.

The Jezebel spirit goes outside of her divine order. God gave men a divine order and women a divine order; the Jezebel spirit says, I can do what he does. It hates the prophets of God and feels it is better than you. It is a very aggressive spirit, becoming a man and dominating men: a maneater. That is the woman minister jumping in the pulpit, the one in the video: do y’all see the cleavage on this ho today?, and now even an Israelite sister who knows she is an Israelite teaching on the street with a microphone.

Every woman has the potential of becoming a Jezebel, and the only way she can become a Jezebel is if you are an Ahab: yes dear, I understand dear, jumping when she says jump.

If your wife smacks your wee wee and says get your little dirty penis out of here, I don’t want that thing; if your wife calls you a Beach, b-e-a-c-h, I’m being nice, a-s-s, y’all know the rest: chances are you have a maneater.

precepts.why: Lydia was a seller of purple from Thyatira, a woman who worshipped God and heard Paul. The Lord opened her heart so that she attended to what Paul spoke. She heard Paul teaching in Thyatira. Thyatira is Greek for daughter, and on the map it sits under the church of Pergamos.

Ahab came into his house heavy and displeased because Naboth would not give him the inheritance of his fathers, and Jezebel his wife came to him. “But there was none like unto Ahab, which did sell himself to work wickedness in the sight of the Lord, whom Jezebel his wife stirred up.” None like Ahab, a black man. He jumped when she said jump, and she portrayed herself as holy.

We want the sisters to learn the scriptures, and that is a good thing. The negative comes in when she only studies the scriptures to battle you, to shut you the f up. That is a Jezebel spirit. Brothers courting a sister: if she pulls scriptures on you to let you know she knows more than you, don’t marry her. She’s not ready to be a wife yet; she’s a Negro, leave her alone.

A sister on Instagram told another sister that 1 Timothy 2 is not a law: that’s Paul’s suggestion in a letter. For you sisters that say that is a suggestion or advice that Paul gave: “If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.”

Commandments. When Paul wrote have one wife, that was a commandment of the Lord, not a suggestion. When Paul wrote I suffer not a woman to teach, that wasn’t a suggestion or advice; it was a commandment. He further says, as also saith the Lord.

sense.text:
Demetrius made silver shrines for Diana and brought the craftsmen much gain. Paul was persuading people throughout Ephesus and almost all Asia that gods made with hands were no gods. Demetrius was worried about the loss of their livelihood and the loss of Diana's standing. Religion and money were bound together.

This is the Greek goddess Diana, which was also the Canaanite goddess Ashtoreth, where Easter comes from: the moon goddess, the goddess of fertility. All of those breasts because she represented sexuality, sex, and people committed orgies under her dominance. This was about female power, female dominance.

It relates to us very much today. The Kemetic community: who do they say is goddess on earth? The black woman. All that black woman worship goes back to this. When Paul went throughout Asia Minor he was preaching against Diana, preaching against woman dominance, teaching them Christ the black Messiah, and everybody was mad as hell at him because he was interfering with their money.

The craftsmen cried out for Diana, the city filled with confusion, and the crowd seized Gaius and Aristarchus and rushed into the theatre. Paul wanted to enter, but the disciples and friends among the chief men of Asia kept him from doing so. Most of the assembly did not even know why they had gathered. When Alexander was recognized as a Jew, they cried for Diana for about two hours.

Black people love confusion: you just throw a chair. Watch how many black people look at World Star, see somebody get cursed out or beat up; you don’t know what the hell’s going on, and black people gather around with their cell phones. Can you imagine, for two straight hours these black people screaming great is Diana of the Ephesians? That uproar shows how deeply this goddess worship held the city. The doctrine did not disappear from people's minds the moment they heard Paul. The instructions sent to Timothy in Ephesus had to address those former beliefs and restore God's order.

precepts.why: Paul calls Timothy his own son in the faith and reminds him that he was left at Ephesus to charge some that they teach no other doctrine. Ephesus is the city of Diana. Timothy has to keep the congregation from bringing its former goddess religion into the truth. That is the setting for the instruction about women learning in subjection.

sense.text:
A woman is to learn in silence with all subjection. Paul does not suffer a woman to teach or usurp authority over the man. Shut the hell up; do not bring that spirit up in here. He is undoing the order of Diana worship among converts in Ephesus. A woman learning the Bible is right; a woman using it to take authority over the man is the problem.

But women rule, the black woman is the goddess of the universe: Paul said I suffer not a woman to teach because they wanted to bring those same characteristics into Israel. Feminism.

The Bible calls idols devils because they give out a deceiving spirit of role reversal. Diana of the Ephesians today is called Wonder Woman, put throughout the commercials, the cartoons, the movies, the woman be whooping the hell out of men left and right; they’re changing all the male superheroes into female superheroes. Iron Man’s going to be a girl, Wolverine a girl, Thor a girl; they made the black woman the queen of Asgard. America is a compilation of every captivity we were under, Babylon, Greece, Persia, Rome, and it all goes back to feminism, worshipping the females.

Adam was formed first, then Eve. Adam was not deceived, but the woman was deceived and was in the transgression. Paul gives the reason from the beginning; it is not simply a local custom with no spiritual basis. The order of creation and the fall explain why the woman must not usurp the man.

It does not mean, sisters, just pop out a baby and you’re going to be saved. Half of you are single mothers; you ain’t going to be saved just on the fact that you can pop out a baby. The conditions follow: continue in faith, charity, holiness and sobriety. Holiness, meaning the commandments; with sobriety: wisdom. The pain of childbirth recalls Eve's transgression and the order God pronounced afterward. A woman must keep the faith and God's order, not merely give birth.

precepts.why:
“In sorrow thou shalt bring forth children”: why? It brings to remembrance you trying to usurp authority over Adam. That’s what those childbearing pains and those menstrual cramps is all about. “And thy desire shall be to thy husband”: you could be subject to your husband in all things, like it says in Ephesians the 5th chapter.

I know the Negro American black woman, she mad about that: why I got to subject myself to the nigga? Because God said subject yourself to the nigga, and if you don’t do it you ain’t gonna be saved. That’s what they’re calling us right now. “And he shall rule over thee”: the American Negro woman don’t like that. Only the repentant Israelite woman will accept that. This is the fight Timothy had in Ephesus.

sense.text: Christ gave her space to repent of her fornication, and she did not repent. The problem is not that no correction or opportunity was given; she refuses it. Rebellion is witchcraft and stubbornness is idolatry. When a woman exalts her own words above God's, that is the spirit being corrected.

“Behold, I will cast her into a bed, and them that commit adultery with her into great tribulation, except they repent of their deeds.” It is more than one woman: she had followers in the church, men and women following women. My prayer is that you repent.

“And I will kill her children with death”. Her children are her followers. If you follow a woman, God cannot use you in this great work. Some of you men online know you follow a woman: your wife can do no wrong, she is the mother goddess.

There are others in Thyatira who do not hold this doctrine and have not known the depths of Satan. There are levels to that wickedness: yielding to a rebellious woman, money, your own lusts and white worship. Christ puts no other burden on those who have kept away from it.

A mother can counsel her son to do wickedly. A husband can listen to his wife against God's command, as Adam did. Do not let loyalty to a mother or wife become permission to disobey God. Some men allow a woman to hit them, dominate them or use sex to control them, then defend her against every correction. You got two types of Israelites in IUIC: men that will do Ezekiel 13:17, and brothers that go, no, the woman can do no wrong. I’ve seen you brothers teaching on YouTube: you captains who will teach a class and the woman is a goddess, your whole class catered to the woman, brother, humble yourself to your woman. I say to you captains, I’m going to see how long this BS goes on. And sisters go, did you see Captain such-and-such’s class? I don’t care what Bishop said, Captain so-and-so says the man must cater to the woman. I’m giving you captains a chance to repent, because we’re going to come down on you with two feet on your neck. You know who you is, and we see you.

When we first set up IUIC a woman would say some crazy stuff and she had some followers in the church. I would do a class to cut it, and the husband would pull up and contradict every scripture we went over to cater to this woman. We got the same thing going on now. Brothers of Thyatira, today is your day: you better fix that. Atlanta mad: why that black bucktooth always coming out here? The Lord sent me here cuz there’s some stuff going on here; something going on down south.

The correction is to repent and fix the church. Christ does not tell everybody to leave the congregation because it has a problem. Address the sin, allow repentance and restore the right order.

This is not hatred of women or an instruction for women to remain ignorant. Righteous sisters learn the scriptures, help their husbands, raise their children and teach younger women. Their abilities are valuable in the place God appointed. What must stop is turning that ability into authority over the man. The black-only doctrine comes from the woman: the weak, effeminized men, their wives counsel them to follow suit in this doctrine. When you see a woman talking about I’m Harriet Tubman, that’s them black-only Negroes. Deborah was subject to the governors and was married; Barak was not her husband. His weakness led to the honour going to a woman. Do not turn that history into permission to reverse God's order.

Remember the Statue of Liberty is based on the Roman goddess Roma, the goddess of justice. That’s why you got this spirit of female dominance throughout America, and it’s only in European countries. The two women that went to Afghanistan with that lesbian stuff got the hell beat out of them and imprisoned for the next twenty years. When we went to Africa a woman on the street said, do y’all teach that the man is the head of the house? That’s what we believe here. We didn’t have to teach her nothing. Not the negropean black woman.

“But that which ye have already hold fast till I come.” Hold the understanding and the scriptures already given. The sixty-six books with the Apocrypha, eighty books, are enough to hold until Christ comes. Stop chasing other books as though God has left you without what you need.

The one who overcomes and keeps Christ's works to the end receives power over the nations. His works are God's law, covenants, statutes and commandments. The end is Christ's return or the end of your life; keep doing the work until then. The kingdom is not equality among the nations. Israel is given power to rule them.

The rod of iron is rule that enforces God's law. The nations are broken like a potter's vessels. We’re going to put the dietary law throughout the earth: any nation caught eating bat, snake, frogs is going to get broke, meaning judged terribly by the Israelites under Christ. We ain’t going to play with the nations. Their true national identities will be restored: China as Moab, Japan as Ammon and the Palestinians as Philistines. This is the authority the Father promised Christ, and Christ shares it with those who overcome.

The power to take the kingdom belongs to that future fulfillment. Not now. Do not turn a prophecy of what the Lord will do then into an excuse for some crazy brother to act now. The Lord appears over his people, gives them power and brings the promised rule.

The morning star is Christ. He gives greater wisdom and understanding, making the overcomers like him. Whoever has an ear must hear what the Spirit says to the churches. These promises and corrections require understanding and obedience.

precepts.why: Y’all know this one: she repented not. “For rebellion is as the sin of witchcraft, and stubbornness is as iniquity and idolatry.”

The men knew their wives were burning incense to other gods, and the women stood in a great multitude with the people dwelling in Egypt, in Pathros. They answered Jeremiah that they would not hearken to the word spoken in the Lord's name. Instead they would do whatever went out of their own mouth and burn incense to the queen of heaven.

That is open rebellion: our own mouth over God's word. The queen of heaven is the same goddess spirit seen in Isis and Diana. The women insist on it and the men allow it. This explains the Jezebel doctrine that the church has been tolerating.

“Set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart”. God commanded us men to set our faces against the daughters of our people. Some of the women were making up their own prophecies, because here in Babylon they were worshipping the female goddesses. “And prophesy thou against them”: God commanded us to prophesy against our own black and Latin women.

Some of you men here are scared to do that thing. You go home and your woman is dominating you: you are an Ahab. Brothers, start calling these brothers Ahab when their wife does something evil as hell and they make excuses for her. He is an Ahab, a weak feminine man.

“But Jehoiada the priest commanded the captains of the hundreds, the officers of the host, and said unto them, Have her forth without the ranges: and him that followeth her kill with the sword.” Bring Athaliah outside, and him that followeth her: him, the man. Kill him with the sword.

That is what God is saying: no man that follows a woman can God use. He is going to kill you. It is not your order to follow a woman. That is why Christ threatens Jezebel’s children, the ones who follow her.

“For his mother was his counsellor to do wickedly.” Some of you brothers listening, it’s either your mama or your wife is your counselor, or your big sister: you are not a man. In New York a brother said sister such-and-such is my counselor; you better get the hell up on out of here.

We have seen in IUIC mothers counseling their sons in wickedness. Where’d you get that from, brother? My mama. You sisters that married his mama’s boy, shame on you: marrying him is like marrying his mama, mama calling you on the phone and paying you a visit. Who wants to live like that?

How quickly we forget what God said to Adam: “Because thou hast hearkened unto the voice of thy wife”. Adam, you listened to your wife; you didn’t listen to me. You followed what she said to do.

Some of you brothers have to sit back, take a deep breath and ask: is that me? When my wife speaks, do I jump? Do I ask, how high, dear? Does she smack my wee wee and tell me I don’t want none tonight? Does she put me in a headlock, punch me in the face? These are true stories. Some brothers are quiet because they are thinking about that thing. Now you are in trial: do you serve the one living God, or do you serve your wife?

“And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, and her hands as bands”. This is a woman that runs the house. The brother that bangs the table, I run my house: no, you run around the house; he puts on those red high heel shoes. Every brother we saw bang the table and say they run their house, they literally were the ones running around the house; some of them left up out of here in 2018 and they’re doing videos. She is always trying to trap you up from doing the work of God; she must have the last word, and you shut up and listen to her. “whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her”. Escape comes through pleasing God, not catering to the rebellion.

This is the Jezebel spirit in a home or congregation. Men in leadership cannot keep excusing it while professing to teach the opposite. The instruction is to correct the sin and repent, not abandon the church whenever a problem appears. Righteous sisters receive their place as helpers and teachers of children and younger women; the snare is the woman making herself a goddess over the man.

Moses asks the Lord, the God of the spirits of all flesh, to “set a man over the congregation”. That man goes out and comes in before them, leads them out and brings them in, so they are not sheep without a shepherd. The leader, including the one leading them to war, is a man. This is the order the goddess religions try to reverse.

A sister came for counsel: I wanted to have sex with my husband and he don’t want to have no sex with me. So what did you do? I punched the nigga in the face, five times. She had some poundage on her. New York, this is your time; headquarters, this is your time. The Most High named her woman because she is of man: her whole existence is supposed to be about helping, being an aid to her husband, and the elder women teach the younger women to love their husbands. Not this gender BS; that’s not in the Bible. All the idols the nations have made are deceivers: whatever God says to do, the idol is set up to go against that.

“But his law have they despised, and denied his covenants; in his statutes have they not been faithful, and have not performed his works.” His works are bound to his law, covenants and statutes. Keeping Christ's works to the end means remaining faithful in these things, not inventing a religion in which obedience no longer matters.

We are going to rule them with a rod of iron. “In that day shall the Lord defend the inhabitants of Jerusalem; and he that is feeble among them at that day shall be as David”: the feeble among us are going to be like King David, a mighty man. “And the house of David shall be as God, as the angel of the Lord before them.”

That is spiritual power: the power the Most High is going to give us to rule the nations.

“But the saints of the most High shall take the kingdom”. We ain’t going to ask for a dag on thing; we are going to take the planet Earth. That is the kingdom. How? With the power the Most High is going to give us: the feeble among us like David, and the house of David as God, as the angel of the Lord.

Turn to the strong hold, prisoners of hope. The strong hold is the Bible. We are the prisoners of hope: America is a prison house, in case you didn’t know it. The Lord promises double, bends Judah as his bow and fills it with Ephraim, raising Zion against Greece, which is us raised up against Esau, and making his people like the sword of a mighty man.

The Lord is seen over them; his arrow goes forth as lightning, he blows the trumpet and goes with the whirlwinds of the south. He appears above his people with the angels and chariots. That is when the power to take the kingdom is given. It is not now; do not mistake the future judgment for a present command to act.

God sets his king on the holy hill of Zion and declares him his Son. He tells him to ask for the heathen as his inheritance and the uttermost parts of the earth as his possession. “Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.” The Father promised Christ that rule over the whole earth. Revelation repeats the promise as Christ gives a share in it to the overcomers.

“And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ”. The faithful Israelites of the first resurrection inherit with Christ. What the Father promised him in Psalms 2, he shares with them in Revelation 2: power over the nations and the rod of iron. The inheritance is why Christ can promise them what he received of his Father.
